context: The momentum preregistration (momentum_preregistration.json) found significant NEGATIVE long-short alpha at 20-day (-12.05%/yr, t=-3.08) and 60-day (-7.69%/yr, t=-2.16) horizons on 2001-2016 development data -- momentum reversed rather than continued at these horizons. This test flips the same two signals: buy Q5 (recent laggards), avoid Q1 (recent leaders). Distinct from beta_idio_1d (the earlier daily, extreme-mover, single-day-hold reversal test that was FALSIFIED): this is weekly, rank-based across the full quintile (not a small tail of extreme movers), and the candidate mechanism is liquidity provision / overreaction correction across the cross-section rather than bad-news continuation cutting off winners.

signal_definitions.reversal_20d: same as momentum_20d: trailing 20-trading-day return ending at Friday close. Ranked descending; LOW signal (recent losers) = long leg, HIGH signal (recent winners) = short/avoid leg -- the mirror image of momentum_20d's long/short assignment.
signal_definitions.reversal_60d: same as momentum_60d: trailing 60-trading-day return ending at Friday close. LOW signal = long leg, HIGH signal = short/avoid leg.

universe: identical to momentum_preregistration.json: full Sharadar PIT eligible universe excl. Finance/Real Estate, same liquidity/history filters.
multiple_testing_correction: Bonferroni across the 2 horizons tested here: alpha=0.05/2=0.025, adjusted threshold t>2.24 for independent standalone significance.

falsification_criteria.reversal_20d: PASSES if long-short (Q5-Q1) alpha t>2.24 AND long-only Q5 small-cap alpha t>2.0; SUGGESTIVE if 2.0<t<2.24 or long-only alpha positive but t<2.0; FALSIFIED if long-short t<2.0.
falsification_criteria.reversal_60d: PASSES if long-short (Q5-Q1) alpha t>2.24 AND long-only Q5 small-cap alpha t>2.0; SUGGESTIVE if 2.0<t<2.24 or long-only alpha positive but t<2.0; FALSIFIED if long-short t<2.0.
falsification_criteria.cost_sensitive_override: Any horizon that otherwise PASSES or is SUGGESTIVE, but whose annualized cost estimate exceeds 3%/yr, is reclassified COST_SENSITIVE.

note_on_expected_direction: This test is NOT independent of the momentum test's data -- the point estimate is mechanically the negative of the momentum spread already measured. What is new here is (a) confirming the LONG leg (buying Q5, not just shorting Q1) carries a genuine long-only-implementable positive small-cap alpha, since a short-only edge isn't tradeable long-only, and (b) checking whether the effect survives cost/turnover and factor control on its own terms as a distinct 'buy the laggards' strategy rather than as the mirror of a falsified momentum test.
